description: Minimum total paid to a nonemployee in a calendar year that triggers a Form 1099-NEC.
source: Pre-2026 amount is the long-standing $600 threshold in the IRS Instructions for Forms 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC. The 2026 amount reflects the increase to $2,000 enacted by the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (2025), indexed for inflation from 2027. VERIFY both against the current IRS instructions before relying on them; the indexed years are intentionally absent.
